name: Spanish coffee chat generated stress case

content.title: The Ten-Minute Coffee Chat
content.themeSummary: A beginner Spanish-speaking journey focused on practical conversation confidence, short consistent practice, reducing speaking freeze-ups, and completing a real ten-minute coffee chat.
content.goalSummary: Build beginner Spanish conversation confidence so the user can complete a ten-minute coffee chat in Spanish, ask follow-up questions, and avoid switching back to English immediately.
safetyNotes: Use low-pressure practice and pause if frustration spikes.

acts.title: Foundations for Speaking
acts.summary: Set up the tools and prompts that make speaking practice easier than freezing in the moment.

mainQuests.title: Build the coffee-chat prompt kit
mainQuests.description: Create Spanish conversation topics, follow-up questions, and rescue phrases for practice and the real chat.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A saved note contains at least five coffee-chat topics, three follow-up questions for each topic, and five recovery phrases in Spanish.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Turn scattered vocabulary into usable conversation support.

mainQuests.title: Set the speaking practice calendar
mainQuests.description: Block weekday and weekend practice time around real constraints so Spanish speaking becomes routine.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A calendar or checklist shows weekday practice blocks and one longer weekend practice block for the next two weeks.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Build consistency and protect practice time from daily distractions.

sideQuests.title: Sort the useful words
sideQuests.description: Review scattered vocabulary and mark words most likely to come up in a coffee chat.
sideQuests.doneCondition: A notebook page contains a labeled set of high-use coffee-chat words selected from existing vocabulary.
sideQuests.rewardIntent: Connect study material to the exact speaking situation.

sideQuests.title: Audit the app lessons
sideQuests.description: Identify which language app exercises help speaking and which ones do not move conversation forward.
sideQuests.doneCondition: A short written audit identifies which app exercises felt useful for speaking and which ones did not.
sideQuests.rewardIntent: Use the app as a tool instead of letting it dominate the learning plan.

bossFights.title: First live mini-chat pressure test
bossFights.description: Hold a very short Spanish exchange using the prompt kit and recovery phrases.
bossFights.doneCondition: A live or recorded Spanish exchange of at least two minutes is saved, and notes show at least one recovery phrase was used instead of immediately switching to English.
bossFights.rewardIntent: Create a visible proof point that speaking anxiety is being faced with a safe, controlled test.

acts.title: Building Conversation Stamina
acts.summary: Move from isolated phrases into repeated short conversations and answer-follow-up cycles.

mainQuests.title: Complete weekly speaking reps
mainQuests.description: Use weekday practice slots to speak Spanish out loud, answer prompts, and rehearse mini-conversations.
mainQuests.doneCondition: At least six weekday practice sessions are logged with a short note showing what was spoken and what felt difficult.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Build repetition so speech feels less foreign and more automatic.

mainQuests.title: Drill follow-up questions
mainQuests.description: Practice turning one answer into two or three conversational turns by asking follow-up questions.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A practice log or recording shows three separate drills where one prompt led to at least two follow-up questions in Spanish.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Strengthen the behavior that keeps a coffee chat alive.

mainQuests.title: Train the listen-and-respond loop
mainQuests.description: Listen to short Spanish audio and answer with simple responses tied to key words heard.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A recording or notes file shows at least three listening sessions with written responses or spoken replies tied to specific key words heard.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Bridge the gap between understanding fragments and participating in conversation.

sideQuests.title: Create shorthand speaking notes
sideQuests.description: Condense the prompt kit into cue words that can be glanced at quickly during practice.
sideQuests.doneCondition: A one-page cheat sheet contains abbreviated Spanish cues for topics, questions, and recovery phrases.
sideQuests.rewardIntent: Support memory during live conversation without forcing full memorization.

sideQuests.title: Review one recording each week
sideQuests.description: Listen back to one practice recording and identify one strength and one phrase to improve.
sideQuests.doneCondition: One practice recording has a written review with one strength and one improvement note saved alongside it.
sideQuests.rewardIntent: Build the habit of learning from evidence rather than vague self-judgment.

bossFights.title: Five-minute Spanish conversation challenge
bossFights.description: Hold a five-minute conversation with prepared prompts, follow-up questions, and recovery phrases.
bossFights.doneCondition: A five-minute conversation is recorded or witnessed, and notes show at least two follow-up questions plus one moment of recovery without switching to English.
bossFights.rewardIntent: Prove endurance and recovery under real conversational pressure.

acts.title: The Coffee Chat
acts.summary: Prepare, rehearse, and complete the real ten-minute Spanish coffee chat.

mainQuests.title: Prepare the coffee-chat plan
mainQuests.description: Assemble the topic list, follow-up questions, recovery phrases, and a short self-introduction into one ready-to-use note.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A single coffee-chat note file is complete and ready to review before the conversation.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Lower friction right before the live chat.

mainQuests.title: Rehearse the ten-minute chat
mainQuests.description: Run a timed practice version of the coffee conversation to test pacing, topic transitions, and recovery phrases.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A timed rehearsal lasts ten minutes, and notes show which topics were covered and where help or simplification was needed.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Make the real chat feel familiar and reveal what still needs adjustment.

mainQuests.title: Complete the real coffee chat
mainQuests.description: Hold the actual ten-minute coffee conversation in Spanish, use follow-up questions, and keep the exchange going without immediately switching to English.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A post-chat reflection or message note confirms that the conversation lasted ten minutes, included follow-up questions, and stayed primarily in Spanish.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Produce the central real-world outcome the adventure is built to support.

sideQuests.title: Write the post-chat reflection
sideQuests.description: Capture what worked, where freezing happened, and which phrases helped after the real conversation.
sideQuests.doneCondition: A reflection entry is saved the same day as the chat and names at least one success and one improvement area.
sideQuests.rewardIntent: Turn a single conversation into a reusable learning loop.

bossFights.title: Coffee chat review gate
bossFights.description: Review the evidence from the real conversation and decide whether the next practice cycle needs more recovery phrases, more listening, or more live speaking reps.
bossFights.doneCondition: A written review summarizes the conversation length, follow-up questions used, moments of freezing, and the next adjustment to practice.
bossFights.rewardIntent: Convert the live chat into a stable next step instead of a one-off event.

skills.name: Speak under pressure
skills.description: Practice saying short Spanish phrases out loud when nervous or blank.

skills.name: Ask follow-up questions
skills.description: Turn a simple reply into a longer exchange by asking clarifying or personal questions.

skills.name: Listen for key words
skills.description: Catch familiar words, names, places, and basic verbs in spoken Spanish.

skills.name: Recover after mistakes
skills.description: Pause, simplify, and rephrase when a word is missing instead of switching languages.

skills.name: Build a practice routine
skills.description: Set up a realistic weekday and weekend speaking routine that fits limited time.

inventoryItems.name: Conversation prompt list
inventoryItems.purpose: Use this list of coffee-chat topics and follow-up questions to remove decision fatigue before speaking practice.

inventoryItems.name: Weekly speaking schedule
inventoryItems.purpose: Use this calendar or checklist to protect weekday practice time and reserve the longer weekend slot.

inventoryItems.name: Reflection tracker
inventoryItems.purpose: Record each practice session, what felt hard, what went well, and phrases to reuse next time.

inventoryItems.name: Recovery phrase notes
inventoryItems.purpose: Keep rescue phrases for asking someone to repeat, slowing down, or staying in Spanish when stuck.

inventoryItems.name: Coffee chat notes
inventoryItems.purpose: Collect prepared topics, personal vocabulary, and follow-up questions for the real ten-minute conversation.

achievements.name: First five-minute Spanish chat
achievements.description: A short live conversation happens with follow-up questions and limited reliance on English.
achievements.unlockCondition: Unlocked when a recorded live or practice conversation reaches five minutes in Spanish and the notes show at least two follow-up questions.

achievements.name: Ten-minute coffee chat complete
achievements.description: The target conversation is completed with prepared topics, follow-up questions, and a reflection afterward.
achievements.unlockCondition: Unlocked when the coffee chat lasts ten minutes, includes at least three follow-up questions, and a written reflection is saved the same day.

focusedNextActions.title: Write a coffee-chat topic list
focusedNextActions.description: List five simple topics to ask about in Spanish.

focusedNextActions.title: Schedule two practice slots
focusedNextActions.description: Put one weekday practice session and one longer weekend speaking session on the calendar.
